summary: AlembicCore CO-5B completed as a producer-first Core-only implementation. Commit 377ecb4 Add public test fixture migration surface extends the existing stable @alembic/core/test-fixtures subpath without adding package exports, resurrecting @alembic/core/project-intelligence, deleting legacy transitional routes, or editing sibling repositories. Changed files: src/test-fixtures.ts now exposes real Core-backed migration helpers for AST project analysis (analyzeFile/analyzeProject/isAvailable/parseToTree/prepareProjectAnalysisTestFixtures), discovery registry/parser helpers, core analysis classes, named language plugin fixtures, LanguageService, selected panorama/project-intelligence test helpers, FileDiffSnapshotStore helpers, and evaluateProjectAnalysisIncrementalPlan. test/PublicTestFixturesSurface.test.ts verifies the new surface against real grammar reload, AST project analysis, discoverer/parser behavior, analysis classes, language plugin fixtures, and LanguageService behavior. test/PublicCapabilityOutputEntrypoints.test.ts and scripts/smoke-public-api.mjs now guard the expanded test-fixtures exports. config/public-api-boundary.json now records CO-5B migration readiness from @alembic/core/core/analysis, @alembic/core/core/ast, @alembic/core/core/ast/*, @alembic/core/core/discovery, and AstAnalyzer test consumers toward ./test-fixtures. Package export counts remain unchanged: 60 total, 53 exact, 7 wildcard; old transitional exports are still present for later consumer migration/shrink. Downstream migration map: AlembicPlugin CallGraphAnalyzer.test can import analysis classes and typeScriptAstPlugin/getAstLanguageTestPlugin from @alembic/core/test-fixtures instead of core/analysis and core/ast/lang-*; RealProjectBootstrap/Enhancement/Go/Discovery can import getDiscovererRegistry/resetDiscovererRegistry and parser helpers from test-fixtures instead of core/discovery; RealProjectAst/Language/Discovery can replace retired project-intelligence aggregate usage with test-fixtures analyzeFile/analyzeProject/isAvailable/LanguageService/prepareProjectAnalysisTestFixtures/discovery helpers; Panorama/FileDiff/IncrementalPlanner residual tests can import the real test-only helpers from test-fixtures. Residual blockers are intentionally left for controller/consumer packages: sibling imports and allowlists still need a separate AlembicPlugin/Alembic migration task; no legacy routes are removable until those scans go clean; KnowledgeService aliases, service/quality, service/bootstrap, and RecipeContext unused-kind decisions remain out of CO-5B scope.
